room_rent.note: SI 5L–20L: up to Deluxe room. SI 25L–1Cr: any room. Optional Room Rent Enhancement add-on available to upgrade to any room for SI 5L–20L. Proportionate deductions apply on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen.

icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of in-patient treatment; no separate sub-limit stated.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned for Signature Plan.

sub_limits.display: Bariatric capped; Delivery capped; ART capped; some others
sub_limits.note: Bariatric: ₹3L–₹6L. Delivery: 10% of SI up to ₹2L. ART: ₹1L–₹5L. Home care: 10% of SI up to ₹5L. Hospice: 10% of SI up to ₹5L. Cataract: actuals. Newborn: 10% of SI up to ₹2.5L–₹5L. Road ambulance: actuals. Rehab & Pain: sub-limits or 20% of SI.

deductible.note: No inbuilt deductible. Optional aggregate deductible (₹25K/₹50K/₹1L) or per-claim deductible (₹5K/₹10K) available at additional premium.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 12 or 24 mo via optional PED Buy Back)
ped_waiting.note: Base: 36 months for 1-year and 2-year terms; 25 months for 3-year term. Optional PED Buy Back add-on can reduce to 12 or 24 months. Optional Insta Care Cover waives PED waiting for Asthma, Hypertension, Cholesterol from 31st day.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for 1-year and 2-year terms; 18 months for 3-year term.

maternity.display: Covered (24mo wait for ART; 2yr wait for delivery)
maternity.note: Delivery expenses: 10% of SI up to ₹2L; requires 2 years continuous coverage (both spouses) or 4 years (insured woman alone). Max 2 deliveries lifetime. ART: waiting period 24 months. Surrogacy and Oocyte Donor also covered. In-Utero Fetal Surgery covered up to SI.

cumulative_bonus.note: 100% of SI after first claim-free year; 25% of SI for every subsequent claim-free year; max 500%. Bonus not reduced until utilised in a claim; only utilised portion reduced at renewal. Alternatively, No Claim Discount of 4% (SI 5L–7.5L), 2% (SI 10L–1Cr) in lieu of CB.

restoration.note: Unlimited automatic restoration for any illness/disease/injury including same illness and modern treatments and accidents. Reset up to 100% each time. Available on partial or full utilisation. Unutilised reset not carried forward to next year.

domiciliary.note: Covered for illness requiring hospitalisation but treated at home for >3 days. Several conditions excluded (asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, etc.). Additionally, Home Care Treatment benefit covers 14 specific conditions up to 10% of SI or ₹5L.

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to sum insured. Yoga & Naturopathy require prior company approval.

organ_donor.note: Donor: additional SI up to basic SI for redo surgery/ICU complications. Insured as donor: covered up to SI. 24-month waiting period. Stem cell donation excluded except bone marrow transplant.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance at actuals per hospitalisation. Air ambulance: 10% of SI per policy year (no stated monetary cap for Signature Plan).

modern_treatments.note: All modern treatments covered up to sum insured. Includes robotic surgery, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, intravitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, oral chemotherapy, etc.

consumables.note: Consumables (List I items including gloves, nebuliser kit, oxygen cylinder, etc.) covered inbuilt up to sum insured for admissible in-patient/day care claims.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit is India only. No international cover available.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes.

notable_exclusions: Commercial surrogacy excluded; reversal of sterilisation excluded; cosmetic surgery excluded; hazardous sports excluded; no global cover
optional_riders: PED Buy Back (12/24 mo), Insta Care Cover (31st day for Asthma/BP/Cholesterol), Room Rent Enhancement, Hospital Cash, Aggregate/Per-claim Deductible, Personal Accident (AD&PTD)
